# Flex Direction

::: info 实现进度 50% · 进行中
布局 / 字号 / 语义色 helper 已进 SDK。调色盘（gray/red/yellow/green/blue/cyan/indigo/purple/pink 50–900）已写入 `helpers-palette.css`。`hover:` / `focus:` / 全量 `m:` `pc:` 色盘仍缺，所以不能标已完成。
:::

父节点先写 `flex`，再用方向类。复杂布局也可以直接用 `type: flex`。

```schema
type: page
body:
  - type: container
    bodyClassName: flex flex-col gap-2
    body:
      - type: tpl
        className: bg-muted p-sm rounded-md
        tpl: 上
      - type: tpl
        className: bg-muted p-sm rounded-md
        tpl: 下
  - type: container
    className: m-t-sm
    bodyClassName: flex flex-row-reverse gap-2
    body:
      - type: tpl
        className: bg-muted p-sm rounded-md
        tpl: 甲
      - type: tpl
        className: bg-muted p-sm rounded-md
        tpl: 乙
```

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `flex-row` | `flex-direction: row` |
| `flex-row-reverse` | `flex-direction: row-reverse` |
| `flex-col` | `flex-direction: column` |
| `flex-col-reverse` | `flex-direction: column-reverse` |

响应式：`m:` / `pc:` 已接到间距、宽高、display / flex、语义色。状态前缀见 [辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
